limits: Same source, 24 questions, prior coverage and frozen actual-source-equivalence oracle. Different routing architecture/prompt/output contract and seen-ID handling; this is not an index-only causal ablation.
Strict success requires all requested missing goals, sufficient actual reads, no unrequested/unsupported/redundant references. Coverage alone is separately reported and is not strict success.
Provider blocks and unattempted cases are separate; Gemma stopped at terminal 429 without retry and cannot be rated for semantic quality.
Model advertised capacities are not quota entitlements; countTokens index-only is 32176, first complete Gemini generation reports about 33K input.
No teacher generation, pedagogy or scientific-answer accuracy test; no extra model call verifying the returned text.
Catalog includes all extracted headings, not merely the printed TOC. Source kinds/structure retain inherited extraction imperfections and 28 unresolved printed-TOC matches.

First valid reply/full reads for Gemini and Sol retained after a local optional analytics INSERT failure; only unattempted cases resumed. Original interruption preserved, no provider request repeated.
Sol provider token counters may be missing: unknown, not zero; actual prices/cost not audited.
Latency is routing plus real reads, valid responses only, sequential cases under pacing; not a causal speed comparison.
